description: Debris-flow in five adjacent gullies in a limestone mountain range is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by degruyter.com. Debris-flows are infrequent Geomorphic phenomena that shape steep valleys and can represent a severe hazard for human settlements and infrastructure. In this study, a debris-flow event chronology has been derived at the regional scale within the Gesäuse National Park (Styria, Austria) using dendrogeomorphic techniques. Coverage: AT. Its keywords include Schutzgebiet, Geowissenschaften, Nationalparks Austria, Naturschutz, OpenDocument. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF.
